title: ACP providers (Cursor, Gemini) with delayed command description never establish linked-worktree test placement
outcome: Found by the Claude reviewer of w-5c8b45a10439 R4 (delegation-839e869d, Low 1). An ACP provider whose command description arrives after the start (Cursor, Gemini) never establishes linked placement, so a genuine test in a distinct linked worktree of the session's repository is refused. w-5c8b45a10439 excludes this case. Fix direction: capture the linked admin identity at the pending start.
acceptance: An ACP delayed-description test command in a distinct linked worktree of the session's repository associates like a Codex or Claude one, shown by a behaviour test that fails before the fix.
The review pair is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
